verdict.rationale: Omarchy is a Linux desktop distribution, so an on-demand performance or power-profile toggle is a fair axis. The evidence pack never documents such a mode. Related items do not deliver the story: graphics drivers sorted at install, near-native CPU performance for the Windows VM, and a battery status hotkey are adjacent features, not a performance mode toggle.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can boost hardware performance on demand using a performance mode toggle
